Chapter 533: Chapter 22: Core Members Of The Magic Jade Tower (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 533: Chapter 22: Core Members of the Magic Jade Tower (Please Subscribe)

Virtual World, atop countless mountains.

Evolver after Evolver appeared at the summit, earnestly comprehending the segment of a body suspended below the sky.

This segment, from an extramundane Supreme Being, was weakened by the Virtual World and had become a ‘training ground’ for Human Civilization’s Seventh and Eighth Rank Evolvers.

Though there were some risks during the comprehension,

following the preliminary summaries by many previously comprehending Evolvers, the risks had been reduced to a certain extent.

The dangers were small, yet the advantages were many.

...

Such as tempering the Spirit Will,

such as understanding the countless Demonic Evolution Paths within the body.

Driven by many factors, such Virtual Worlds had been semi-opened.

Any human Evolver who met the strength and conditions could apply for entry, no longer restricted to just the genius Evolvers as before.

“Look, there’s the Galaxy Master.”

“Yes, it is the Galaxy Master.”

“Wow, after watching so many videos of the Galaxy Master, to finally see him in person.”

…

Evolver after Evolver on the other mountains, upon seeing Lin Yuan sitting cross-legged at the summit, buzzed with excitement.

The many deeds of Lin Yuan had already spread throughout the five major star sectors of Human Civilization, with countless billions of Evolvers holding fervent and even worshipful feelings for this Galaxy Master who kept creating miracles.

“The Galaxy Master is comprehending here, and I’m also comprehending here; doesn’t that mean I’ve cultivated alongside the Galaxy Master?”

“The Galaxy Master is already so powerful, yet he’s still so engrossed in cultivating; I shouldn’t indulge myself any longer.”

Lots of Evolvers exchanged ideas rapidly, their tones excited, with a few being motivated to cultivate even harder.

…

Lin Yuan had long noticed the gazes from the Evolvers atop other summits.

But he did not pay them any mind; his main focus was almost entirely on understanding the Demonic Evolution Path within the body.

The Demonic Evolution Path, that’s what Statue Shen Ji called the countless paths of Evolution Paths within that sectional body.

Indeed, the many Evolution Paths within that body were sufficiently ‘demonic’; not a single one was completely perfect, but the mysteries they contained were unequivocally real.

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding is comprehending the unknown body, penetrating the thirty-three thousand three hundred and twenty-fifth Demonic Evolution Path…]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding is comprehending the unknown body, penetrating the thirty-three thousand three hundred and twenty-sixth Demonic Evolution Path….]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding is comprehending the unknown body, penetrating the thirty-three thousand three hundred and twenty-seventh Demonic Evolution Path…]

…

Lin Yuan comprehended quickly. Where other Evolvers took months or even years to fathom a single Demonic Evolution Path, he needed only less than half an hour to penetrate it thoroughly.

To penetrate, not to fathom.

His Against-Heaven’s Understanding was dictated by the height Lin Yuan stood at. When he first contacted this sectional body, Lin Yuan was merely at the Seventh Rank and found comprehension quite strenuous.

But now, having reached the limit of the Eighth Layer and just a step away from stepping into the Ninth Rank, his comprehension speed and efficiency naturally increased substantially.

“The thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-third Demonic Evolution Path…”

Soon, Lin Yuan began to comprehend the last Demonic Evolution Path.

“This Demonic Evolution Path speaks of emotions…”

Lin Yuan felt it carefully.

All life has emotions, the issue is only of degree.

To master emotions is to control oneself and even control those lives who cannot rein in their own emotional desires.

“Who would have thought, the emotions of life can be utilized in this way?”

Lin Yuan was inwardly astonished. He had always focused on the vast rules but neglected that emotions, an intrinsic part of life itself, could be so useful.

Among the countless Evolution Paths recorded by Human Civilization, there were some about the use of emotions and desires, but none were as detailed and specific as this Demonic Evolution Path.

“Emotions and desires are part of me. There’s no need to cast them aside…”

Lin Yuan silently opened his eyes. At the same time, this Demonic Evolution Pathway was entirely penetrated.

Just as Lin Yuan penetrated the thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-third Demonic Evolution Path,

Boom.

Deep within his soul, the ‘Nine Floors Dark Tower’ shaped Magic Jade Mark began to grow profoundly darker in color. In its vagueness, it became more substantial, as if it were not just a mark, but a real ‘Nine Floors Dark Tower’.

The next moment.

The Psychic Will Pressure from that body and the murmuring sounds filling his ears suddenly became clear, as if a deep and hoarse male voice echoed:

“Eighth Layer life form penetrating thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Demonic Evolution Paths is automatically admitted as a core member of the Magic Jade Tower.”

…

“Core member of the Magic Jade Tower!”

With determination in his heart, Lin Yuan recognized that a core member of the Magic Jade Tower held status much higher than that of ordinary members—they were the true elite of the Tower.

Had the Tower been at its peak, a core member would have been personally summoned by the Moyu Tower Master. Even now, with the Tower Master gone, one could still inherit the Secret Techniques left behind.

This was why Lin Yuan, rather than hastily stepping into the Ninth Rank, chose to remain at Eighth Rank to penetrate thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Demonic Evolution Paths.

There was a difference in the standards of life for ordinary and core members of the Tower.

Lin Yuan had long communicated the task of penetrating three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Demonic Evolution Paths to the Goddess of Wisdom, but to date, not a single human Evolver had become a standard member of the Tower?

Was this because those at the Ninth, Tenth, and Eleventh Rank were foolish?
